LightningComponentBundle.description: Displays the packaged company logo (a static resource) in a Tableau Next dashboard widget with scale, alignment, and opacity controls. No external URLs, no third-party libraries.

property.name: staticResourceName
property.label: Static Resource Name
property.description: Optional. Name of a static resource in this org to show instead of the packaged logo. Leave blank to use the packaged logo.

property.name: imageScale
property.label: Image Scale
property.description: Fit to Width: full width. Fit to Height: full height. Fill: fills the widget (may crop). Original: natural size (may crop).

property.name: horizontalAlignment
property.label: Horizontal Alignment
property.description: Horizontal position of the image within the widget.

property.name: verticalAlignment
property.label: Vertical Alignment
property.description: Vertical position of the image within the widget.

property.name: backgroundColor
property.label: Background Color
property.description: Optional CSS color behind the image (e.g. #ffffff). Leave blank for none.
